from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareMetric(BaseModel):
    """A per-share earnings-equivalent metric reported in a specific filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name as named in the filing")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label used in the document (e.g. 'Basic Earnings Per Share', 'Distributable Income per Unit')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the metric")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the label and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_metrics: list[ShareMetric]
